title: All-h original six-incidence source-forest classification into nine eligible path cells
statement: For every genuine W(3,2^h), h>=1, any set Q of six distinct ACTUAL original source point-line incidence IDs induces an acyclic bipartite source subgraph, since GQ girth is eight. Among Q whose original point-side and line-side factor multiplicities BOTH belong to A=(1^6), B=(2,1^4), or C=(2^3), maximum original source degree is two, and Q is a disjoint union of source paths. Exactly NINE feasible source forest cells are A/A (path lengths 1^6); A/B,B/A (2,1^4); A/C,C/A (2,2,2); B/C,C/B (4,2); B/B-overlap (3,1,1,1); B/B-disjoint (2,2,1,1). C/C is impossible by GQ girth. Sets with other original source multiplicities fall OUTSIDE the nine eligible cells, not into an invented tenth GF5 positive class.

quantifiers.domain: integer h>=1, s=2^h, genuine original W(3,s)
any complete separately typed globally injected ORIGINAL point and line maps shared across all true source six-ID sets

external_dependencies: Genuine original GQ incidence graph has girth 8; six distinct ORIGINAL incidences determine a forest.
Root repeated-point and repeated-line source factors for B/B determine whether their genuine original common flag occurs among Q.
limitations: The nine path types classify eligible genuine SOURCE multiplicity supports; they do not guarantee any physically positive GF(5) class under fixed f,g.
A/A is only accepted when both physical positional duals share the same connected aligned D6.
Other original sixsets with multiplicities outside A/B/C exist and must not be silently relabeled into this nine-cell universe.
falsification_boundary: Test six DISTINCT original W(3,s) point-line incidence IDs, not synthetic six-coordinate cycles, repeated events, or arbitrary source-free physical graphs.
